name: Red Sift OnDMARC
summary: Red Sift OnDMARC monitors DMARC reports and manages SPF and DKIM records from one dashboard. The Express plan is listed from $9 a month billed annually, covering up to 4 domains and 1 million monthly emails. The Essentials, Enterprise and Premier plans are sold on request.

facts.text: On the product page, OnDMARC protects and reports on every domain and subdomain, and translates aggregate reports into a sender dashboard.
Red Sift OnDMARC's product page says the platform configures SPF, DKIM, DMARC, BIMI and MTA-STS in one place. It describes a Dynamic SPF feature that consolidates records to avoid SPF lookup limits.
Product page: OnDMARC can block unauthorised senders and prevent exact-domain spoofing.

The Express plan lists up to 4 domains, up to 1 million monthly emails and 30 days of data history. Essentials, Enterprise and Premier list 25, 25 and 50 active sender domains, with unlimited email volume and one year of data history.
